euler.name: Leonhard Euler
euler.role: Swiss mathematician and physicist; author of E325 (1765/1767) establishing the six center distances and the Euler line

feuerbach.name: Karl Wilhelm Feuerbach
feuerbach.role: German geometer; author of the 1822 Nuremberg monograph proving the fourfold tangency of the nine-point circle

buzengeiger.name: Karl Heribert Ignaz Buzengeiger
buzengeiger.role: Professor of Mathematics at the University of Freiburg; Feuerbach's mentor and author of the 1822 Vorrede

euclid.name: Euclid of Alexandria
euclid.role: Author of the Elements and the Data; axiomatic foundation for Euler's and Feuerbach's synthetic demonstrations

apollonius.name: Apollonius of Perga
apollonius.role: Author of the Conics and De Tactionibus; originator of the Apollonian circle-tangency problem

pappus.name: Pappus of Alexandria
pappus.role: Author of the Synagoge (Collection), Book VII on ancient geometric analysis and harmonic division

menelaus.name: Menelaus of Alexandria
menelaus.role: Author of the Sphaerica; discoverer of the transversal collinearity criterion dual to Ceva's theorem

ceva.name: Giovanni Ceva
ceva.role: Italian geometer; author of De lineis rectis se invicem secantibus statica constructio (1678) proving cevian concurrency

fagnano.name: Giovanni Francesco Fagnano dei Toschi
fagnano.role: Italian mathematician; proved in 1775 that the orthic triangle minimizes inscribed perimeter inside an acute triangle (cited by Feuerbach § 19)

lhuilier.name: Simon Antoine Jean L'Huilier
lhuilier.role: Swiss mathematician; developed symmetric relations among the four tritangent radii in Gergonne's Annales (1810, cited by Feuerbach § 2)

fuss.name: Nicolaus Fuß
fuss.role: Swiss-Russian mathematician and Euler's assistant in St. Petersburg; extended bicentric polygon center distances in Nova Acta Petrop. X (1797, cited by Feuerbach § 49)

brianchon.name: Charles Julien Brianchon
brianchon.role: French projective geometer; co-published with Poncelet in 1820–1821 the nine-point concurrency on the hyperbolacircle locus

poncelet.name: Jean-Victor Poncelet
poncelet.role: French geometer; co-author with Brianchon (1821) of the independent French proof of the nine-point circle

terquem.name: Olry Terquem
terquem.role: French mathematician; coined the term 'nine-point circle' (cercle des neuf points) in 1842

stewart.name: Matthew Stewart
stewart.role: Scottish geometer; published Stewart's cevian quadrance identity (1746) underlying Euler's § 18 collinearity relation

altshiller-court.name: Nathan Altshiller-Court
altshiller-court.role: Author of College Geometry (1925; 2nd ed. 1952), systematizing the Euler line, nine-point circle, and Feuerbach configuration

kimberling.name: Clark Kimberling
kimberling.role: Creator of the Encyclopedia of Triangle Centers (ETC), indexing X(1)–X(5) and the Feuerbach point X(11)

wildberger.name: Norman J. Wildberger
wildberger.role: Developer of Rational Trigonometry (Divine Proportions, 2005), formulating geometry over exact quadrance and spread
